About the job

We're looking for a Pricing & Promotion Specialist to join a fast-paced, bootstrapped, and profitable US-based DTC performance marketing agency that has generated over $1.5B in sales for innovative consumer brands.




This is a full-time remote role for someone who is hungry to grow fast and be developed by the best. You'll work directly under a Senior Performance Marketing Manager who will coach and develop you across pricing strategy, promotional mechanics, and statistically rigorous experimentation — with a clear path toward a Performance Marketing Manager role.




This is not a passive support role. You'll be in the work every day — running tests, pulling analysis, building frameworks, and contributing meaningfully to offer performance across a portfolio of DTC brands. You won't specialize into one narrow lane. You'll develop across pricing, consumer psychology, funnel design, and experimentation all at once.




If you're looking for a role where performance is the culture and not just a department, this is it.




Requirements




2–4 years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, direct-response marketing, or a closely related field
Hands-on exposure to eCommerce or DTC offers — with some involvement in pricing, promotional, or conversion optimization work
Familiarity with experimentation concepts: A/B testing, hypothesis development, and metric interpretation
Comfort working with performance data and translating it into decisions
Strong written and verbal English — this is a US-hours, cross-functional role
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-directed — you manage multiple workstreams without dropping balls
Comfortable collaborating with creative, data, and media buying teams




Responsibilities




Support the development and execution of pricing, bundling, and promotional strategies across assigned DTC offers
Help build and refine offer frameworks including bundle ladders, upsell flows, discount structures, BOGOs, limited-time offers, and urgency-based mechanics
Execute pricing and promotion experiments in our experimentation platform, from test setup and QA to readout and documentation
Analyze experiment results across metrics including AOV, RPS, EPC, refund rate, and network margin
Support hypothesis development and define success and guardrail metrics for assigned tests
Maintain organized experiment logs and readouts that build institutional knowledge
Collaborate daily with Campaign Ops, Creative Strategy, Data, and Traffic teams
Contribute recommendations based on performance data and offer results




Nice to Have




Experience with Statsig, Optimizely, VWO, or a similar experimentation platform
Proficiency in Tableau or a similar BI tool
Background in affiliate or partner marketing
Prior agency or startup experience
Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth, or performance-driven environment
Familiarity with Monday.com or similar project management tools
Demonstrated results improving AOV, AOM, or RPS




What Success Looks Like




90 days in: You've completed onboarding across platforms and systems, have a working command of our experimentation infrastructure, and are actively supporting live tests with increasing confidence.

6 months in: You're a reliable execution partner — launching, analyzing, and documenting experiments end-to-end, and building strong relationships across cross-functional teams.

12 months in: You're operating with growing autonomy, proactively surfacing opportunities, and showing the instincts and output quality that signal readiness for expanded responsibility.

Real Estate Marketing & Coaching Company | Full-Time Contractor Role | Remote (EST)




SalesGenius is an AI-powered marketing agency that partners with real estate agents across North America to help them build predictable, scalable, deal-closing businesses. We combine AI tools, performance marketing, and automated lead generation systems to help agents attract more clients, convert faster, and operate smarter.




We are seeking a high-performance CRM & Automation Specialist with Media Buying Experience who can own results across two core areas: building and managing the tech systems that power our clients' lead pipelines, and running Meta ad campaigns that keep those pipelines full.




This is NOT solely a task-taker role.




This is for someone who is equally comfortable inside GoHighLevel building a nurture sequence as they are inside Ads Manager optimizing a lead gen campaign. You are technically proficient, client-facing, and you do not wait to be told something is broken before you fix it.




🎯 MISSION OF THE ROLE

Keep SalesGenius clients' tech stacks running, their leads flowing, and their ad campaigns performing. In this role you will own both sides of the client delivery engine: building and managing CRM workflows, automations, and tech integrations across tools like GoHighLevel, Follow Up Boss, Lofty, Make, and Zapier, and launching, running, and optimizing Meta ad campaigns using existing frameworks and structures already built inside client accounts. title: Volunteer Marketing and Communications Lead to Connect Stakeholders Working to End Deep Polarization with Colombia Construye Confianza
description:
About the job

This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Fellow 

Ashoka Fellows are leading social entrepreneurs that have been taken through a rigorous selection process, testing the quality of their ideas and character, to become part of the Ashoka Fellowship and Network. Ashoka Fellows take on the challenges of building innovative system change ideas to make and spread social impact in a world wrought with challenges. They refuse to let the ‘impossible’ stand in their way to creating a better world.

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Colombia Construye Confianza (CCC) was founded to address one of Colombia's most urgent social challenges: deep polarization among citizens who have lost the ability to trust one another. We work with communities, organizations, and institutions to transform the way people relate, building the social trust that democracy and coexistence require. Our flagship methodology, BAKONDO, has reached over 3,200 people over more than 20 years, earning recognition from the World Economic Forum, Coca-Cola, and One Young World. Through experiential education, play, and art, we bring together volunteers and vulnerable communities to form empathetic leaders. Our most powerful program, BAKONDO Paz, unites ex-combatants, victims of the armed conflict, and social leaders to run a camp for children in vulnerable situations, turning former adversaries into builders of peace.

For more information, please visit www.colombiaconstruyeconfianza.org

Job Description

Colombia Construye Confianza is seeking a strategic marketing volunteer to help us design and deploy a comprehensive communications strategy that connects us with all our key stakeholders. We recently developed our brand concept and initial materials with a creative agency, and now need someone to take that foundation and turn it into an active, results-driven marketing operation. The volunteer will design the overall communications and marketing strategy for CCC and its initiatives, including our BAKONDO bootcamps. They will define the right channels, messages, and tactics to attract volunteers, corporate partners, donors, universities, and impact investors. They will also help manage and optimize our social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp, and support the team in executing campaigns consistently. Their work will directly determine how many people discover, trust, and join our mission, making it essential to the growth and sustainability of the organization. Please let us know today if you can help!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 5

The estimated duration of the project is: 3-6 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

Spanish

Desired Skills And Experience

We are looking for a professional with demonstrated experience in marketing strategy and digital communications, ideally within the social impact, NGO, or purpose-driven brand space. The ideal candidate has strong skills in content strategy, social media management, and audience segmentation, and knows how to translate a compelling mission into messages that move people to act. Experience working with multiple stakeholder audiences (corporate, institutional, and grassroots) is highly valued. Proficiency in Spanish is required; English is a plus. A background in impact communications, social entrepreneurship, or international development will help the volunteer hit the ground running.

About the job

Responsibilities
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time.

About the role:
TikTok is seeking a Client Partner (what we call 'Brand Partnerships Manager') to support our Key Accounts (Enterprise) business and be based out of the Mexico City office. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in cross-network solutions selling and a proven ability to reach and influence executive level customers to drive new business. The candidate will have operational knowledge of in-region clients and experience dealing with executive stakeholders across Social, Video, Mobile, Digital teams. A proven track record in scaling client investment is a must.
Above all, the candidate will have an established track record of building strong relationships across key stakeholders. The role will involve working cross-functionally with members of the TikTok sales organization with the intent of onboarding priority accounts across the market. You’ll bring a creative mindset, detail-oriented focus, and strategic acumen in your approach to building and growing long term business partnerships across advertising technology partners.

Responsibilities:
1. Identify, prioritize, and secure business opportunities
2. Drive revenue for TikTok by seeking partnerships with various direct clients and agencies 
3. Use consultative approach by offering strategic media solutions with all clients 
4. Create compelling sales propositions utilizing internal and external data for respective regions
5. Liaise with cross-functional teams on structuring and executing operational and strategic initiatives
6. Create persuasive sales presentations using market trends and case studies
7. Update clients on TikTok products and developments and educate clients and agencies on best practices

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
1. 5+ years of marketing, brand advertising, media sales, and/or online advertising experience
2. Expert knowledge of social media, mobile apps, and digital and mobile marketing
3. Knowledge of the self-serve platform, auction, and biddable form of digital advertising buying
4. Proven performance winning the support of key stakeholders
5. Proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales goals
6. High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-speaking markets.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Ability to perform well in a rapidly changing environment
2. Creative, outside-the-box thinker and strategist
3. Excellent communication and presentation skills
4. Passion for TikTok marketing, and up for the challenge of building something from the bottom up

In-Office Policy: We are currently working in the office 4x a week in Polanco and are moving to 5x a week in office (full-time) starting Fall 2026.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Oportunidad profesional en Inteligencia Artificial

Estamos en búsqueda de Ingenieros y/o especialistas en Inteligencia Artificial con mentalidad innovadora y pasión por construir soluciones avanzadas basadas en datos. Esta persona participará en el diseño e implementación de sistemas inteligentes que aprovechen modelos de lenguaje de última generación, Python y el ecosistema de Google Cloud Platform.




El rol está enfocado en el desarrollo de agentes inteligentes y arquitecturas basadas en Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) para resolver desafíos complejos y habilitar nuevas capacidades tecnológicas dentro de la organización.

Desarrollo de agentes inteligentes

Construir soluciones autónomas basadas en modelos de lenguaje avanzados (familia Gemini u otros), capaces de automatizar procesos y mejorar la interacción con usuarios y sistemas.

Diseñar pipelines que integren modelos de lenguaje con fuentes de conocimiento internas para generar respuestas contextualizadas, precisas y confiables.

About the job

Operations & Supply Chain Coordinator

Company: DP Gayatri Mexico




About Us:

DP Gayatri Mexico is the Mexico operations division of the DP Gayatri Platform, supporting manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain operations across North America.




We specialize in high mix, low volume manufacturing for industrial automation, semiconductor equipment, medical devices, robotics, and OEM customers. Our focus is on delivering quality cable assemblies, wire harnesses, electrical assemblies, and contract manufacturing support while building a reliable cross-border supply chain serving customers throughout Mexico and the United States.




This is an opportunity to join our team during an exciting growth phase and help build the operational foundation of our Mexico business.




Position Overview:

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Operations & Supply Chain Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of DP Gayatri Mexico.




This role is responsible for coordinating purchasing, supplier relationships, outsourced manufacturing, production planning, logistics, inventory, and administrative operations while working closely with our engineering and operations teams in both Mexico and the United States.




The successful candidate will support customers, suppliers, and manufacturing partners across North America while helping build scalable operational processes as our business continues to grow.




This is not simply an administrative position. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, building supplier relationships, and helping scale a growing manufacturing business.




Key Responsibilities:

Supply Chain & Purchasing

Source electrical components, wire, connectors, terminals, and manufacturing materials
Obtain supplier quotations and negotiate pricing
Create and manage purchase orders
Build and maintain supplier relationships throughout Mexico
Identify, qualify, and develop new suppliers
Monitor supplier performance, quality, pricing, and delivery




Operations Coordination

Coordinate production schedules with outsourced manufacturing partners
Monitor production status and delivery commitments
Support production planning and scheduling
Verify work instructions, Bills of Material (BOMs), and engineering documentation are current
Coordinate first article builds and engineering changes




Logistics & Inventory

Coordinate domestic and international shipments
Work with customs brokers and freight providers
Prepare import/export and shipping documentation
Track inbound and outbound shipments
Maintain inventory accuracy
Support material planning and inventory replenishment




Customer & Cross-Border Coordination

Support customer requirements for both Mexico and U.S. customers
Coordinate priorities between customers, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and internal teams
Communicate production status, material availability, and shipment updates
Support sourcing requests, quotations, and new manufacturing opportunities
Help resolve supply chain, quality, and delivery issues




Quality Support

Coordinate incoming and outgoing inspections
Verify workmanship meets customer quality expectations
Support supplier corrective actions
Maintain quality and production documentation




Administration

Update ERP and inventory records
Maintain purchasing and supplier documentation
Prepare operational reports
Coordinate communication between suppliers, customers, and internal teams
Support daily business operations




Business Development Support

Visit suppliers and manufacturing partners
Attend local manufacturing and industry events
Help identify potential suppliers, manufacturing partners, and business opportunities
Represent DP Gayatri Mexico professionally within the manufacturing community




Qualifications:

Required

3+ years of experience in manufacturing, purchasing, supply chain, operations, production planning, or production coordination
Professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal)
Strong organizational and time management skills
Experience working with suppliers, purchase orders, and inventory management
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment




Preferred

Experience in electronics manufacturing, cable assemblies, wire harnesses, industrial automation, contract manufacturing (EMS), or electrical manufacturing
Experience using ERP or MRP systems
Understanding of Bills of Material (BOMs), engineering drawings, engineering change processes, and manufacturing documentation
Knowledge of import/export logistics, customs processes, and cross-border supply chains
Experience supporting customers, suppliers, or manufacturing operations across Mexico and the United States
Experience working in a high mix, low volume manufacturing environment




What Success Looks Like:

Within your first year, you will help establish the operational foundation for DP Gayatri Mexico by:

Building a reliable supplier network throughout Mexico
Coordinating high-quality manufacturing with outsourced production partners
Supporting customers across both Mexico and the United States
Improving purchasing, logistics, and operational processes
Helping develop scalable systems that support the future growth of our North American manufacturing operations




Why Join DP Gayatri Mexico?

Help build a growing North American manufacturing business from the ground up
Work directly with company leadership and have a meaningful impact on business growth
Gain hands-on experience in supply chain, operations, manufacturing, logistics, and international business
Work with customers and suppliers across both Mexico and the United States
Opportunity to grow into an operations leadership role as our Mexico division expands
Collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and initiative make a difference

description:
About the job

About the Company

Cosign is one of the fastest-growing companies in U.S. rental real estate. We act as a lease guarantor for renters who do not meet traditional credit or income requirements, expanding housing access for hundreds of thousands of people while giving property managers the security they need to approve more applicants. The company is profitable, scaling quickly into new markets, and is led by a three-time founder previously recognized on the Forbes 30 Under 30 list.

Our product is proven. Our brand is early. You are the bridge.




The Role & Team

We are making our first dedicated design hire. As a core member of the Marketing team reporting directly to the Head of Marketing, you will define the visual DNA of a fast-growing company and serve as the essential link between marketing strategy and engineering execution.

This is not a production role. You will own brand, web, content, and sales design end-to-end, with real authority over how the company looks and feels in the market.




The Mission: What You’ll Own

You will be responsible for the end-to-end visual experience of Cosign across four primary pillars:

Brand Systems: Evolve our existing brand book into a living design system. You’ll define component guidelines and visual tone to ensure Cosign feels premium and consistent.
Webflow & SEO Growth: Own the website. You will design and build city-level landing pages in Webflow, optimizing for conversion and "AI-readiness" (ensuring we surface correctly in Search, ChatGPT, and Perplexity).
Content Amplification: Turn our podcast and long-form content into a high-growth engine by repurposing episodes into viral-ready reels, carousels, and quote cards.
Sales & Partnership Collateral: Design high-stakes pitch decks and partner assets. You’ll build a "Self-Serve" template library (Canva/Figma) so the team can move fast without breaking the brand.




Your Toolkit

We are looking for a "New Age" designer, someone who uses AI to 10x their output and Webflow to bypass developer bottlenecks.




Must-Haves:

Webflow: Ability to build, launch, and update responsive, production-ready pages independently.
AI-Fluent: Active use of Claude, GPT, Midjourney, Sora, or Gemini to generate imagery and accelerate workflow.
Figma: Intermediate/Advanced. You build clean, component-based files.
CapCut: A "social-first" eye for video editing (pacing, captions, hooks).
Canva: You use it to empower the team with locked-down, easy-to-use templates.




Expected Experience

3-5 Years of Professional Design Experience: Specifically within digital product or performance marketing environments.
International Track Record: Proven experience working with international clients or global brands, demonstrating an understanding of high-growth market standards (specifically North America).
Live Production Portfolio: You must have a portfolio of live, in-production websites and digital products. We want to see how your designs hold up in the real world, not just in Figma mocks.
Startup Pedigree: Experience in fast-paced environments where you’ve had to take a project from a rough brief to a finished, public-facing asset.




The Deal

Fluent in written and spoken English; you communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team and write a copy that reads native.
Location: 100% Remote. 
Schedule: This role requires full alignment with US Eastern Time (New York). You will work directly alongside our leadership during EDT business hours.

Support the field sales team by analyzing data, providing insights, managing tools, and optimizing sales strategies to enhance overall performance and achieve sales targets.

Data Analysis & Reporting

Collect, analyze, and interpret sales data, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to support the field sales team and management. Ensure data accuracy and consistency across reporting tools.

Sales Performance Tracking

Sales Tools & Reporting Enablement

Support the management and continuous improvement of sales reporting tools and dashboards. Ensure the field sales team has access to accurate and relevant data. Act as a point of contact for reporting-related queries and improvements.

Training & Support

Provide basic training and support to field sales teams on reporting tools and data interpretation. Promote best practices in data usage and reporting. Help ensure the team is equipped to use data effectively in their daily work.

About the job

En Puig somos una compañía global, familiar y con más de 110 años de historia, dedicada a crear experiencias únicas en el mundo de la belleza y el bienestar. Nos impulsa la innovación, el emprendimiento y el desarrollo de las personas, trabajando con marcas icónicas que inspiran confianza y generan un impacto positivo en la vida de nuestros consumidores.




En nuestra División Derma, representamos marcas líderes como Uriage y Apivita, reconocidas por combinar ciencia, innovación y naturaleza para ofrecer soluciones de cuidado dermatológico con los más altos estándares de calidad.

Hoy buscamos a una persona apasionada por las ventas, el liderazgo de equipos y la ejecución comercial, que quiera impulsar el crecimiento de nuestras marcas y transformar la experiencia del consumidor en el punto de venta.




Tu propósito




Como Supervisor(a) de Ventas – Sell Out y Activaciones , serás responsable de garantizar la excelencia en la ejecución comercial en Guadalajara, impulsando el crecimiento del sell out mediante la correcta implementación de estrategias comerciales, el liderazgo del equipo en campo y la ejecución impecable de activaciones que fortalezcan la presencia de nuestras marcas en el mercado.

Serás un socio estratégico para nuestros clientes y un líder cercano para el equipo, asegurando que cada punto de contacto con el consumidor refleje la propuesta de valor de Uriage y Apivita.




Principales responsabilidades

Liderazgo Comercial

Supervisar y dar seguimiento al desempeño comercial del equipo de campo en farmacias.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de sell out establecidos para cada territorio y cliente.
Analizar indicadores comerciales para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y definir planes de acción.
Dar seguimiento a la productividad del equipo mediante visitas en campo, acompañamientos y sesiones de retroalimentación.




Gestión del Equipo

Liderar, desarrollar y motivar al equipo de Dermoconsejeras y Promotores.
Brindar coaching constante para fortalecer habilidades comerciales y de servicio.
Participar en procesos de reclutamiento, integración, capacitación y desarrollo del talento.
Fomentar una cultura de alto desempeño, colaboración y orientación a resultados.




Activaciones y Ejecución en Punto de Venta

Planear, coordinar y supervisar activaciones comerciales en farmacias y puntos de venta estratégicos.
Garantizar una ejecución impecable de lanzamientos, campañas promocionales y eventos especiales.
Supervisar la correcta implementación de material POP, exhibiciones y lineamientos de visual merchandising.
Colaborar con Marketing y Trade Marketing para maximizar el impacto de cada campaña.




Relación con Clientes

Desarrollar relaciones sólidas con cadenas de farmacia, distribuidores y equipos de tienda.
Detectar oportunidades comerciales que impulsen el crecimiento del negocio.
Asegurar niveles óptimos de inventario y colaborar con las áreas internas para minimizar quiebres de stock.




Análisis y Seguimiento del Negocio

Elaborar reportes comerciales y presentaciones ejecutivas.
Dar seguimiento a indicadores como:
Sell Out
Cobertura
Productividad
Conversión
Ticket Promedio
ROI de activaciones
Generar recomendaciones basadas en datos para optimizar el desempeño comercial.




Trabajo Transversal

Colaborar estrechamente con Marketing, Trade Marketing, Finanzas, Supply Chain y Recursos Humanos para asegurar la ejecución de las prioridades del negocio.
Participar activamente en lanzamientos de productos y proyectos estratégicos de la división.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia mínima de 4 años liderando equipos comerciales en campo.
Experiencia en la industria de Dermocosmética, Belleza, Consumo, Farmacéutica o Retail.
Conocimiento sólido en gestión de sell out, ejecución en punto de venta y activaciones comerciales.
Experiencia supervisando equipos de promotoría o consultoras de belleza.
Habilidad para analizar indicadores comerciales y convertirlos en planes de acción.
Excel intermedio o avanzado.
Disponibilidad para viajar.




Lo que te hará destacar

Buscamos una persona que:

Inspire y desarrolle equipos de alto desempeño.
Sea apasionada por el consumidor y la excelencia en la ejecución.
Tenga una fuerte orientación a resultados y capacidad analítica.
Disfrute construir relaciones de confianza con clientes y equipos internos.
Sea proactiva, resiliente y capaz de adaptarse a entornos dinámicos.
Combine pensamiento estratégico con una fuerte orientación a la operación.




En Puig creemos que las personas son el motor de nuestro éxito. Aquí encontrarás un entorno donde podrás aprender, innovar y desarrollarte profesionalmente, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinarios y marcas reconocidas a nivel mundial.




Si buscas un reto que combine liderazgo, estrategia comercial y cercanía con el consumidor, esta es tu oportunidad para dejar huella y crecer junto con nosotros.

Orchid a global strategic design collective born in 2008, focused on product marketing, now grown into a vibrant team of creative minds around the world, with main hubs in NYC, Singapore and Dubai. As innovation accelerates, great products can transform lives, if people know how to use them. Orchid crafts strategic, product-driven narratives that bridge this gap, turning complexity into compelling stories that drive adoption and make technology accessible. Adaptability flows through our work as we collaborate across continents. Here, your ideas can travel globally, supported by passionate professionals who value fresh thinking and creative solutions.




In Orchid, transparency guides our relationships, ensuring your contributions are recognized and your voice is heard. In our tight-knit, collaborative crew, you'll find room to grow as you help brands tell their stories in ways that are both beautiful and strategic. Your unique perspective isn't just welcomed—it's essential to our success.

description:
About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.


What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …


Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!


Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

description:
About the job

Be at the heart of hiring in a global software company!

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacturing of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived using our software.

Driven by a deep understanding of what it takes to deliver successful products, Siemens Digital Industry Software partners with our customers to provide industry software solutions that help companies everywhere achieve sustainable competitive advantage by making real the innovations that matter.

The role will be a remote/hybrid-based position.

Our Opportunity:

What does it take to build the world’s leading industrial software company? Well, above all else, it takes skilled people, from a diverse range of backgrounds. And that’s why we need forward-thinking Talent Acquisition professionals to enable our growth. Our TA team recruits in more than 40 countries across the globe hiring thousands of new colleagues every year! You might not know the names of each one of our software products, but you’ll recognize our customers, the biggest names in the automotive, aviation, and industrial manufacturing industries.

We are seeking a TA Operations Partner who will work in a highly dedicated and innovative global Customer Experience team working to develop and run best-in-class recruitment processes and procedures.


Support the strategic development of the end-to-end Talent Acquisition supply chain using analytics and sound operational judgement.
Take accountability and drive the cross functional collaboration required to land innovation and practical change.
Contribute to the continuous improvement program which would include working closely with global TA Partner teams
Work to clear expectations, performance measures and goals which are stretching and push operational boundaries and efficiencies
Support the short- and long-term transition plans for the TA Operations team systems, tools, and processes across the organization
Pull and distribute recruiting metrics for internal organizational stakeholders
Assist with vendor partnerships to build and manage resource strategies, execute project plans, and acquire data to support recruitment activities
Manage the contract and pre onboarding aspects of the TA lifecycle


This role will be continuously devolving, this is an exciting time to join the team as you can help shape the delivery model to our TA community!

What we’re looking for:


A passion for Continuous Improvement and Operations Excellence
Analytical mind with high levels of attention to detail
The ability to influence and great communications skills.
Influential and persuasive communicator; we will look for evidence that you can build trustful relationships with people from all backgrounds
Demonstrated understanding of talent acquisition operating procedures and practices, guidelines, HR technology and tools
Ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously and deliver results against clearly defined deadlines is required
Experience with applicant tracking systems is preferred (Workday, Avature).
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) is required.


We choose colleagues with high levels of integrity, who are confident to challenge assumptions to drive our business forward. We’re problem solvers and collaborators, so although you’ll have your own designated responsibilities, we expect every member of our team to share and learn from each other. We value empathy, curiosity, and diligence, and our team is a supportive and open environment. If you're passionate about recruiting, we'll help you to thrive here.

Why Us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

The Jr Brand Manager supports the execution of channel and marketing initiatives for the premium spirits and RTD portfolio, acting as a key link between internal teams and external partners to ensure flawless implementation of brand plans, projects, and initiatives across channels, while driving operational excellence, monitoring performance, managing investments, and identifying opportunities to accelerate business growth through effective commercial activation.

title: Digital Marketing Strategist
description:
About the job

Job Title: Digital Marketing Strategist / Account Manager




About the Company:

Our client is a dynamic, fast-paced digital marketing and sales firm rooted in strong values and a faith-inspired mission. They are a community of creative thinkers, proactive problem-solvers, and growth-minded professionals working to drive real impact through innovation and collaboration.




Job Description:

As a Digital Marketing Strategist / Account Manager, you will play a critical role in managing client relationships, owning account management responsibilities, planning strategic marketing initiatives, and guiding internal teams to deliver exceptional results. You will collaborate directly with clients, support cross-functional teams, and partner with Executive Leadership to determine the best paths forward.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Work 1-on-1 with clients to develop comprehensive marketing plans.

• Understand client goals, translate them into actionable strategies, and ensure deliverables align with expectations.

• Report progress to internal teams and help ensure tasks stay on track.

• Serve as the main point of contact for assigned clients, building strong, trusted relationships.

• Lead regular client check-ins, status updates, and strategy conversations.

• Ensure client needs, expectations, deadlines, and priorities are clearly communicated to the internal team.

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve client results, strengthen relationships, and add value.

• Support client retention by maintaining consistent communication, accountability, and a high level of service.

• Escalate client concerns, blockers, or strategic needs to leadership when appropriate.

• Coordinate with creative, content, web, paid media, and leadership teams to keep projects moving forward.

• Monitor project timelines, deliverables, and client requests to ensure work is completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare meeting agendas, recap notes, next steps, and follow-ups after client calls.

• Help manage client feedback, approvals, and scope conversations with clarity and professionalism.

• Keep internal teams aligned on priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

• Help ensure client communications are timely, professional, and organized.

• Track project status and flag potential risks, delays, or changes in scope.

• Support and oversee email campaigns, including setup, optimization, and reporting.

• Conduct data analysis and prepare performance reports for clients and leadership.

• Assist in sales enablement efforts through strategic planning, tool setup, and content alignment.

• Provide direction or oversight on SEO, social media management, paid digital spend, and general web technologies.

• Help connect marketing performance insights to strategic client recommendations.

• Have a solid understanding of how the CRM works and how information is organized.

• Manage HubSpot to support the sales, marketing, and customer service teams.

• Set up and monitor basic automated tasks and simple processes in the CRM.

• Keep the database clean, organized, and up to date.

• Create easy-to-understand reports and dashboards to show overall progress.

• Troubleshoot common HubSpot issues and help team members use the platform effectively.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience in digital strategy, marketing management, account management, client services, or a CRM-focused role.

• Strong understanding of marketing databases, CRMs, and workflow architecture; HubSpot experience strongly preferred.

• Experience managing client relationships, expectations, timelines, and deliverables.

• Ability to translate complex data and client needs into clear, actionable plans.

• Strong communication and presentation skills for client-facing interactions.

• Familiarity with key digital marketing functions, including email, SEO, paid media, social, and web strategy.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and moving pieces.

• Ability to confidently navigate new tools, technologies, and client environments.




Preferred Skills:

• Strong HubSpot experience is highly beneficial and preferred.




Personality:

• A proactive, adaptable mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

• A commitment to Our client’s core values and a desire to contribute meaningfully to a mission-driven team.




Software & Tools:

• HubSpot experience strongly preferred.

• Marketing databases, CRMs, and workflow architecture.




Schedule:

Full-time




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

description:
About the job

Hola, somos L'Oréal. No solo construimos marcas, damos forma a la manera en que el mundo experimenta la belleza (y se necesitan muchos trabajos interesantes para lograrlo). ¿Intrigado? Sigue leyendo, esta podría ser la oportunidad que has estado buscando.

Un Día en la Vida

Como Ejecutivo de Operaciones, serás una pieza clave en la ejecución comercial y el liderazgo de equipos en punto de venta, impactando directamente los resultados de negocio en México. Liderarás un equipo de entre 12 y 15 dermoconsejeras, asegurando la correcta implementación de estrategias comerciales y el logro de los objetivos de ventas.

Tus Responsabilidades Clave Serán


Alcanzar las metas de ventas establecidas, monitoreando KPIs (planogramas, rentas, descuentos) a través de la aplicación Involves.

Dirigir, motivar y desarrollar al personal propio y externo, asegurando su capacitación en producto y técnicas de venta.
Liderar al equipo de dermoconsejeras (12-15 personas), fomentando un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y orientado a resultados.


Lo Que Buscamos

Buscamos a una persona proactiva, con visión comercial y habilidades de liderazgo, capaz de motivar equipos y ejecutar estrategias en punto de venta con excelencia.

Requisitos


Formación en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios o carrera afín.
2 a 5 años de experiencia en roles de operaciones, trade marketing, ventas o gestión de equipos en punto de venta.
Habilidades de liderazgo, negociación y comunicación efectiva.

Lo Que Tenemos Para Ti


Un lugar para salir de tu zona de confort y crecer más allá de tu potencial (¡te animaremos a intentar cosas nuevas y tomar riesgos!).
Responsabilidad real desde el primer día; en L'Oréal nunca estarás en la banca.
Un ambiente donde personas de cualquier etnia, origen social, edad, religión, género, orientación sexual, así como personas con discapacidad, son aceptadas, pueden expresarse, prosperarán y son celebradas.
Un lugar donde puedes contribuir a algo más grande: muchas de nuestras marcas tienen causas sociales y ambientales para generar un impacto real.


Quiénes Somos

L'Oréal Groupe está presente en 150 mercados en cinco continentes. Durante más de un siglo, L'Oréal Groupe se ha dedicado a un solo negocio: "crear la belleza que mueve al mundo"; hoy es el líder mundial de la industria. Juntos, resolvemos desafíos complejos a gran escala, mientras permanecemos comprometidos con hacer del mundo un lugar más inclusivo y mejor para todos y para nuestro planeta. Esta posición forma parte de la División de Productos de Consumo de L'Oréal Groupe, donde democratizamos los mejores productos de belleza, innovación y calidad, llevándolos a las manos de consumidores en todo el mundo a través de canales masivos y estratégicos como el retail y las farmacias.

Estamos comprometidos con garantizar procesos de reclutamiento inclusivos y con abogar por la contratación y promoción de cada candidato de manera ética y equitativa. El Grupo prohíbe estrictamente la discriminación contra cualquier solicitante de empleo por motivos de identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, discapacidades visibles y/o invisibles, origen socioeconómico y/o multicultural, condiciones de salud, edad, religión, o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

Life tastes better with ice cream 

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

Our client is a well-established consumer products company focused on delivering premium wellness and lifestyle products through both dealer networks and direct-to-consumer initiatives. As the company continues expanding its digital presence and product marketing efforts, they are seeking a Digital Content Marketing Specialist to support product launches, digital campaigns, content creation, and ongoing marketing execution across multiple digital channels.




Role Overview

The Digital Content Marketing Specialist will be responsible for executing digital marketing initiatives that support product launches, campaign rollouts, landing pages, website updates, and social media content. The Digital Content Marketing Specialist will collaborate with internal teams to create engaging marketing assets, maintain consistent publishing schedules, optimize digital experiences, and contribute ideas that strengthen the company's overall digital presence. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on marketing execution, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and combines creativity with strong organizational skills.




Location

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST




Key Responsibilities

Content & Campaign Execution

Support the execution of product launches across digital marketing channels.
Coordinate digital marketing assets for campaigns and promotions.
Repurpose content across social media, email marketing, landing pages, and website content.
Maintain content calendars and publishing schedules.
Coordinate campaign timelines, approvals, and launch activities.




Landing Pages & Digital Assets

Build, update, and optimize landing pages using existing platforms and templates.
Collaborate on promotional messaging, page layouts, and user experience.
Ensure landing pages and digital assets align with brand standards.
Support ongoing website updates and campaign content maintenance.




Social Media & Content Production

Create and edit digital marketing content for social media and campaigns.
Support high-volume content distribution across multiple channels.
Contribute creative ideas for campaigns and audience engagement.
Help maintain a consistent digital brand presence.




Creative Collaboration & Marketing Support

Recommend ideas that improve campaign performance and content quality.
Stay informed on digital marketing trends and best practices.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders on marketing initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing workflows and execution.




Qualifications Experience

2–5 years of experience in digital marketing, content marketing, or campaign execution.
Experience supporting product launches and digital marketing campaigns.

Experience working with consumer products, eCommerce, lifestyle, or product-based brands is preferred.
